anomalies.observed: NAVC2 VSS pins 18 and 63 share a locally named net, Net-(NAVC2-VSS-Pad18), and are not on the GND net. No NAVC2 pin appears on GND. The FCC2 VSS pins (10, 26, 49, 74, 99) are all on GND.
anomalies.expected: Every VSS pin of the STM32F405 (power_in) should be tied to the common ground, as the FCC2 VSS pins are.
anomalies.impact: The NAVC MCU has its ground pins floating, so it cannot be referenced to the board ground and will not operate reliably or at all.

anomalies.observed: PCA9685 A0 (pin 1) is tied to the +3.3V rail, while A1 to A5 are tied to GND. This gives I2C address 0x41, not 0x40.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the PCA9685PW at I2C address 0x40, which requires A0 to be low.
anomalies.impact: The firmware addressing the servo driver at 0x40 would fail to reach the PCA9685 and no PWM outputs would be driven. The INA219 also sits at 0x40 on the same bus, so the A0 strap may have been chosen to avoid a conflict, which would make this a spec inconsistency rather than a fault.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows NAVC2 VSS pins isolated from GND and a PCA9685 address strap that differs from the specified 0x40. Both are plausible deviations, but the wider netlist also contains many unwired MCU pins, so confidence is low.
